<!--
Observable JS (OJS) partial, spliced into stage1_explore.qmd via
{{< include _genome_filtering_widget.qmd >}}.

Kept in its own file purely for readability/maintainability of the widget
logic — `{{< include >}}` is a textual/preprocessing splice (not a runtime
JS module import), so this is fully compatible with stage1_explore.qmd's
`embed-resources: true` self-contained HTML output.

Expects three OJS-defined inputs from the including document (set via
Python's `ojs_define()`):
  - criteria_records   : list[dict] — one row per genome (see §5 data-prep cell)
  - suggested_thresholds: dict — default cutoffs for each criterion
  - min_freq_options    : list[float] — tested --min-freq values
-->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// criteria_records is already row-oriented (Python sent a list of per-sample
// dicts via ojs_define), so no transpose() is needed here — that helper is
// only for the column-oriented {col: [...]} shape Quarto produces when you
// hand ojs_define() a raw DataFrame directly.
data = criteria_records
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// One row per genome, tagged with which active criteria it fails (if any).
evaluated = data.map((d) => {
  const reasons = [];
  // Numeric match, not a string-interpolated key lookup: JS's default Number-to-string
  // drops trailing ".0" (minFreq=1 -> "1") while Python's f-string keeps it
  // ("missing_pct_1.0"), so a `missing_pct_${minFreq}` key would silently never match
  // for whole-number min_freq values.
  const missingEntry = d.missing_by_freq.find((m) => m.min_freq === minFreq);
  const missingVal = missingEntry ? missingEntry.missing_pct : null;

  if (d.checkm2_completeness != null && d.checkm2_completeness < minCheckmComplete) {
    reasons.push(`completeness ${d.checkm2_completeness}% < ${minCheckmComplete}%`);
  }
  if (d.checkm2_contamination != null && d.checkm2_contamination > maxCheckmContam) {
    reasons.push(`contamination ${d.checkm2_contamination}% > ${maxCheckmContam}%`);
  }
  if (requireGuncPass.length > 0 && d.gunc_pass === false) {
    reasons.push("GUNC fail");
  }
  if (d.gunc_css != null && d.gunc_css > maxGuncCss) {
    reasons.push(`GUNC CSS ${d.gunc_css} > ${maxGuncCss}`);
  }
  if (d.busco_completeness != null && d.busco_completeness < minBuscoComplete) {
    reasons.push(`BUSCO C ${d.busco_completeness}% < ${minBuscoComplete}%`);
  }
  if (d.busco_single != null && d.busco_single < minBuscoSingle) {
    reasons.push(`BUSCO S ${d.busco_single}% < ${minBuscoSingle}%`);
  }
  if (d.busco_duplicated != null && d.busco_duplicated > maxBuscoDuplicated) {
    reasons.push(`BUSCO D ${d.busco_duplicated}% > ${maxBuscoDuplicated}%`);
  }
  if (d.busco_fragmented != null && d.busco_fragmented > maxBuscoFragmented) {
    reasons.push(`BUSCO F ${d.busco_fragmented}% > ${maxBuscoFragmented}%`);
  }
  if (d.busco_missing != null && d.busco_missing > maxBuscoMissing) {
    reasons.push(`BUSCO M ${d.busco_missing}% > ${maxBuscoMissing}%`);
  }
  if (d.magpurify_flagged_total != null && d.magpurify_flagged_total > maxMagpurifyFlagged) {
    reasons.push(`MAGpurify flagged ${d.magpurify_flagged_total} > ${maxMagpurifyFlagged}`);
  }
  if (d.genome_size_z != null && Math.abs(d.genome_size_z) > maxSizeZ) {
    reasons.push(`genome-size z=${d.genome_size_z}`);
  }
  if (missingVal != null && missingVal > maxMissingPct) {
    reasons.push(`missing ${missingVal}% > ${maxMissingPct}% (min_freq=${minFreq})`);
  }

  return { ...d, missing_pct_selected: missingVal, fail_reasons: reasons, n_failed: reasons.length };
})

excluded = evaluated.filter((d) => d.n_failed > 0)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(
  excluded.map((d) => ({
    Sample: d.sample_id,
    "In alignment": d.in_alignment,
    Class: d.class,
    "Completeness (%)": d.checkm2_completeness,
    "Contamination (%)": d.checkm2_contamination,
    "GUNC pass": d.gunc_pass,
    "GUNC CSS": d.gunc_css,
    "BUSCO C/S/D/F/M (%)": [d.busco_completeness, d.busco_single, d.busco_duplicated, d.busco_fragmented, d.busco_missing]
      .map((v) => (v == null ? "–" : v))
      .join(" / "),
    "MAGpurify flagged": d.magpurify_flagged_total,
    "Size z-score": d.genome_size_z,
    [`Missing % (min_freq=${minFreq})`]: d.missing_pct_selected,
    "Failed criteria": d.fail_reasons.join("; "),
  })),
  { width: { "Failed criteria": 350, "BUSCO C/S/D/F/M (%)": 160 } }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function downloadText(filename, text) {
  const blob = new Blob([text], { type: "text/plain" });
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = filename;
  a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
}

exportExcludeListButton = {
  const btn = html`<button>⬇ Download exclude_list.txt (${excluded.length} genomes)</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    const text = excluded.map((d) => d.sample_id).join("\n") + (excluded.length ? "\n" : "");
    downloadText("exclude_list.txt", text);
  };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function toCsvRow(values) {
  return values
    .map((v) => {
      const s = v === null || v === undefined ? "" : String(v);
      return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? `"${s.replace(/"/g, '""')}"` : s;
    })
    .join(",");
}

exportCandidatesCsvButton = {
  const btn = html`<button>⬇ Download exclude_candidates.csv (with reasons)</button>`;
  btn.onclick = () => {
    const header = toCsvRow(["sample", "in_alignment", "class", "n_failed", "fail_reasons"]);
    const rows = excluded.map((d) =>
      toCsvRow([d.sample_id, d.in_alignment, d.class, d.n_failed, d.fail_reasons.join("; ")])
    );
    downloadText("exclude_candidates.csv", [header, ...rows].join("\n") + "\n");
  };
  return btn;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div style="display:flex; gap:1rem; margin-top:0.5rem;">${exportExcludeListButton}${exportCandidatesCsvButton}</div>`
```

`exclude_list.txt` contains one genome identifier per line (matching the `sample` column
of the `--input` samplesheet). For genomes **already in the alignment** (`In alignment` =
true above), this name also matches the one embedded in the merged SKF, so the file can be
passed directly via `--ska_delete_samples`. For genomes **not yet built into the alignment**
(QC-only candidates), there's nothing yet to delete from a SKF — instead, drop the
corresponding rows from the `--input` samplesheet before the run that builds/extends the
alignment.
